title: Phases and guided steps
intro: The six playbook phases, the guided steps of each phase, their evidence and the review queue.
gatesUnaffected: Completing phase steps never submits or approves a gate. Gates G1–G6 are business approvals decided by people.
readOnly: You can read the phases here; managing, progressing or reviewing steps needs another role.
arProvisional: Arabic phase and step texts are a provisional translation of the English source text.

catalogue.title: Phase catalogue
catalogue.intro: The six phases in order, with their names, purposes and key outputs as the playbook gives them (B0021).
catalogue.name: Phase

workspace.title: Phase workspace
workspace.intro: Choose a phase to see its objective and guided steps. The current phase is preselected.

rule.evidence_linked: At least one verified evidence item linked
rule.kpi_actual_accepted: At least one KPI actual accepted
rule.raid_register_present: The RAID register has an entry
rule.benefit_validated: At least one benefit measurement validated
rule.corrective_cases_owned: Every open corrective case has an owner and a follow-up date
rule.improvement_backlog_present: The improvement backlog has an item

step.none: This phase has no guided steps.
step.ruleNotMet: Completion rule not met when checked
step.versionNote: Record version {{n}} (0 = not saved yet; the first save creates it).
step.requestTitle: Request a review of this step
step.requestBody: The completion rule is checked now. If it is met, the step goes to the review queue and the reviewers get a task.
step.reviewBody: Accepting checks the completion rule again and completes the step; returning needs a note. The owner cannot review their own step.
step.ownerCannotReview: You own this step, so you cannot review it.

evidence.title: Step evidence
evidence.intro: Evidence linked to this step. Only verified evidence counts towards the completion rule.
evidence.noRow: This step has not been saved yet: assign its owner first.
evidence.ownerOnly: Only the step owner links or removes evidence.
evidence.linkIntro: Choose an evidence item of this transformation.
evidence.removeBody: The link is removed; the evidence item itself is kept.

queue.title: Review queue
queue.intro: Every step of this transformation that is waiting for review.
queue.empty: No step is waiting for review.
